title: MrFEG's Placeable Foods & Drinks
description: Place your food. Share the feast.Shift+right-click any food or potion to set it down in the world — stack up to 4 items on one block, eat when ready, pick it back up anytime
body:
**MrFEG's Placeable Foods** adds a simple but satisfying mechanic — shift+right-click any food or drinkable potion to place it down in the world as a physical object. Perfect for decorating taverns, kitchens, campsites, or sharing food with friends on multiplayer servers.

![MrFEG's Placeable Foods And Drinks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/796b9aadaa17ba6c396b14cd834737c5c9fd5a72.png)

## Features:

- Place any food or drinkable potion on any surface by shift+right-clicking
- Food gives full nutrition only when fully eaten across 4 bites — no cheesing hunger
- Stack up to 4 different foods on one block — mix and match for a proper spread
- Any player can eat from a placed food block — great for multiplayer sharing
- Shift+right-click the block while holding food to add to the stack
- Shift+right-click with empty hand to pick the food back up
- Breaking the block drops all stacked items
